scope: Read-only source review, no new CP benchmark or accepted historical performance measurement.

locations.needle: Our heat full-order reference was not compiled the same way

findings: The archived heat ROM uses fully compiled device loops with diffusivity as a runtime argument; current heat already uses compiled loops and explicit array inputs.
Archived Heat-2D explicitly uses a dense residual without EQ. Do not attribute that cell speedup to empirical quadrature.

The archived Heat-3D FOM uses a Python loop of CG solves and retains every snapshot, whereas the ROM returns initial and final fields. The author correction explicitly reports an unfair FOM compilation setup.
The manuscript compares against CG; the current heat benchmark includes a stronger direct spectral FOM and a coarse interpolated control.

Archived Heat-2D invokes its encoder before the named rollout timer, without a separate completion block, so it does not establish fully charged initialization. It grades final states; the current experiment charges initialization and all requested full outputs and grades every requested time.
The archived Heat-2D rollout advances the decoded state correctly. The frozen public-package regression cannot invalidate the paper run by itself.
The CP decoder factors through a fixed spatial bank and nonlinear coefficient map. Fixed linear weak operators can be preassembled for it as for the current coordinate-bank model.
Factorized spatial reconstruction is a potential further transfer to the current bank; it requires its own accuracy and cost test. No such compression was implemented in this turn.

The new heat comparison uses fixed diffusivity and the current single-bump family. It does not reproduce the paper's variable-diffusivity, multi-bump cases. Its nonlinear query factory captures diffusivity; reuse across changing diffusivity without recompilation is a separate untested extension.

missing_features.archived: Decode a normalized field and solve jointly for latent coordinates and a separate scale.
missing_features.current: Amplitude is represented through latent/head coefficients. out_scale is a fixed bank parameter, not an evolving amplitude state.
missing_features.test: Compare a trained normalized-head plus explicit-scale NMROM using the existing weak time integrator; report the added coordinate and any training changes.

not_proven: The current saved head is not a normalized-shape model; the old encoder/scale weights cannot simply be transplanted.
No new CP-port timing or accuracy gain is established by this source review.
The archived CP speed ratio does not transfer automatically from iterative CG to the current direct spectral/coarse FOM comparisons.
